steps.text: 'The city is a man-eating behemoth, but still we must dwell in its bowels gratefully.'
'We wait until life digests us, until our flesh and bones are excreted, so that whatever remains may become nutrients to feed the city as it lurches onwards.'
'That is the flourishing of civilization.'

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Welcome to the Kazimierz National Arena! Welcome... to the Kazimierz Major! I am none other than your old friend –– Greatmouth Mob!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: After a long qualifying stage, this is the moment all of Kazimierz has long been waiting for –– the first match of the Kazimierz Major starts today!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Dueling, jousting, and assorted miscellany! Three categories, eight major events, forty-three minor events! Countless knights and knightclubs will take their share of gold and glory!

steps.name: An Audience Knight
steps.text: How did Mob end up as the MC? Think he greased some palms behind the scenes?

steps.name: A Popcorn-Clutching Knight
steps.text: Like he bribed his way in? How much do you think something like that would cost?

steps.name: An Audience Knight
steps.text: Mob's never been the type to keep his mouth shut. What if he let something slip, right here on the big stage?

steps.name: A Popcorn-Clutching Knight
steps.text: Hah. You hear about that loudmouth, the Bearded Cage? Heard he 'badmouthed' a pretty big deal of a knight during the Major...

steps.name: A Popcorn-Clutching Knight
steps.text: ...and that was the last anyone saw of 'im. Want some popcorn?

steps.name: An Audience Knight
steps.text: Pssht. Probably just took the fall and resigned. A by-the-book trick.

steps.name: A Popcorn-Clutching Knight
steps.text: *munch* I shed... dish-appeared... *munch*... not resigned. You get it?

steps.name: An Audience Knight
steps.text: Huh... No shittin'?

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Today's Major features eight big knightclubs, sixty-four of the normal ones, and two unaffiliated, independent knights!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The Kazimierz Major is a showcase of the beauty and majesty of our knights for all of Terra to enjoy!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Our first match will pit the Blade Helmet Knightclub against the Cloudhaze Knightclub! How many points will the ten knights from each side take home to their clubs?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: A big prize pool is getting bigger as I speak! A portion of everything you spend at this arena will be added to the tournament prize for the knights to fight over!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Which knightclub will take the most trophies? Which knight will stand above the rest and become this Major's Knight-Champion?

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Now... LET US SEE FOR OURSELVES––!
5:43 P.M. \ Clear
The Grand Knight Territory Kawalerielki, Wall of Champions

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: How's the fit, Mr. Malkiewicz?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Good, thanks to you.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: That's enough of that. Custom-tailored formalwear is a must for maintaining our image.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Do you still have the tailor's contact information? I believe you'll find his services most helpful.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Sir, could you please get me a glass of wine? Thank you.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: What's on your mind?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Nothing in particular...

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Maybe... This banquet is just too much for me.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Ah, 'maybe.'

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Maybe you haven't gotten over the incident with Mr. Czarny. Quite the shame, for all of us.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: He was a conscientious one, who always put his best foot forward, whether as a company employee or as a spokesman for the K.G.C.C.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: In fact, I only met him after becoming a spokesman myself. In terms of our work in the Majors, he was far senior to a fresh face like me.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: He always treated those he respected well, yes?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Maybe...

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Let's do away with these maybes, and lift our spirits instead.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Today is but the second day of the opening ceremonies, and a great day to open the Wall of Champions to the outside world. It would hardly fit the occasion for the resident manager to wear such a dour expression.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Yes, you're right... Sorry...

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: You should speak up more, Malkiewicz. And there's no need to be so stiff around me. It's certainly not conducive to our working relationship.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: What was that? Did something happen outside?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Hmm.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: I believe it's a guest of honor, a very important knight. Let me check the time... See, look how punctual she is. We need more knights like her.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Pardon me, I'll be right back. In the meanwhile, do avail yourself of your right to the open bar.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: S-Sure...

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: The sweet release of libation is wonderful indeed. You ought to indulge in it.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Madam Droste, we meet again.

steps.name: Droste
steps.text: Good evening. Am I late?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Not at all. I'm glad you could make it.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: I do believe the glow of the Candle Knight will add a beautiful touch to tonight's opening banquet.
6:15 P.M. \ Overcast
The Grand Knight Territory Kawalerielki – General Chamber of Commerce, Reception Room

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I—
Ah, no need to explain yourself, Platinum. We didn't expect this to happen either... Just doing your job, of course?
You do what you have to do.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I screwed up.
Ah yes, a screwup... But we aren't exactly nine-to-five office drones here. In our line of work, 'screwups' are very serious.
Deadly serious, even.
Luckily this time, you only let the Radiant Knight barge into the Infected quarter... Oh, but that did throw a wrench into Monique's work.
Her job was to make a little fireworks show out of those illegal settlements, and then bring the Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub to Area 0.
It was going so smoothly, but suddenly... from the slaughter came the Radiant Knight, and there went all our plans.
She's very unhappy now, you understand? We all know her temper, and if someone was to get in the way of her bounty, you know how troublesome that'd be.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I didn't know what Monique was doing.
No, you did know. Besides, whether you knew or not is no excuse.
After all, your job was to 'track the Infected.' Did I not say a long time ago that our jobs would be changing?
Now now, what's with that icy expression? Oh, were you perhaps born with that face, little pegasus?
How seriously can I take someone who submits seventeen or eighteen time-off requests a month? ...Ah, forget it.
Count your lucky stars that the whole thing about the Radiant Knight rushing into an Infected quarters to fight off a group of mysterious assassins didn't make headlines in the major news outlets.
Though the media are still our valued partners, suppressing these kinds of things costs a lot of money. And let me tell you, they don't pass up on these juicy opportunities.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: ...I'll accept responsibility for these losses.
Your self-awareness is commendable, but you can't afford to 'accept responsibility' for many more mistakes. After all, the Board of Directors only pays you so much, yes?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Sorry.
Hah. Enough of that. Playing the villain isn't exactly my strong suit.
We're still work partners, right?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: If you think so, then so it must be, Lord Roy.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Tisk tisk. When you call me that, doesn't it seem like we're strangers? 'Platinum' Centaurea... See, doesn't hearing that make you feel uncomfortable? Why don't we go with a nickname instead, my little pegasus?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Kazimierz has many pegasi.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: It's fine as long as you know I'm referring to you... Oh, right. There's just one more thing, though it's not a very big deal.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: If you're talking about it, there's no way I can treat it as anything less than a big deal.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Then it appears that you misunderstand me. I'm willing to talk to you about all sorts of things, from small talk to important matters... Haha.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Mm. I heard you spared the life of Szewczyk's runt?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Czarny was already removed from his post at that time. I wasn't in the mood to listen to him and kill a kid.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Ah, so frank. That's fine.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Though I also feel bad for Czarny, that isn't the real issue here... Put simply, Szewczyk has gone missing.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Plastic Knight does not come from an esteemed lineage. He's just another tournament upstart.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Though we didn't have any plans to remove him from the picture, he is the property of the Roar Guards Co., and it never bodes well to let someone else take the initiative. We'll definitely get complaints from the K.G.C.C.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Did you find out who did it?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: The Infected.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I don't understand. How could a few Infected knights accomplish all this?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Who knows, little Platinum? That's exactly what we're trying to figure out right now.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: But there's one thing you shouldn't misunderstand.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Oh do please illuminate me.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: What we face... is not just a few meager Infected, but rather all the Infected of Kawalerielki.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Mieszko Industries just delivered eight new plates. The purpose of the plate called Area 0 will soon be brought to light.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: I've mentioned this before, right? We're going to be real busy.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I understand.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Good, as long as you understand. *cough* *cough* Hmm...

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: *hiss*... It's too damn hot today, don't you think? How nice it must be to not have to wear a helm...

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Hm, you can't see what's different about me?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Oh.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: You dyed your hair?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Everything, including my tail. What do you think? Looks good, huh?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Yes, it suits you well.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: What's the meaning of that annoyed look in your eyes?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Don't think I have to answer personal questions, do I?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: But you see, you hold the title of 'Platinum.' White hair, clad in pure white. Monique is Victorian, natural blue hair, lazurite attire. An absolutely perfect fit.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: But look at me, all dark and drab. Standing next to Monique, I'm so out of place, like I'm a janitor or something.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: So out of consideration for our public image, I also decided on a color for myself, heh.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: As long as you're happy.
1:22 P.M. \ Clear
The Grand Knight Territory Kawalerielki – Urban Crevices, Infected Gathering

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: I'm back!

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Took you a while, Sona.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Rude. Some stuff happened along the way.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Ashlock's mentioned it before. Back then, during that 'Industrial Incident,' was it the Radiant Knight that helped you?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Ahaha... Is this the celebrity effect? Feels like everyone already knows...

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: She...

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: What kind of person is she?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Oh, that's adorable. I thought you weren't interested in gossip.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: My hometown...

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Back home, there's an arena.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: There were never any tournaments in that small arena. It was just built because that's what you do, you have an arena in a town.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: But back then... was when I started to look up to the knights. It was also where I grew up hearing legends of the Radiant Knight.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: It's been many years.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Really? You never mentioned that before.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: And when did you tell me about what you were like as a kid?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Fair. Maybe that is something we should talk about later.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: It was a long road.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: The road to the Grand Knight Territory was so very long. I didn't come all the way here to reminisce about my old home.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: We're just chatting, alright? No need to be so uptight.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Just chatting, huh...

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: When the day comes that we can sit around a patisserie with nothing to fear, we can grab Ashlock and Wild Mane and chat the afternoon away.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Good idea.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: So... What kind of person is she?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Well... To be honest, ermm, we only made eye contact. I have no idea if she even saw my face, busy as we were.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: H-Hey, don't look so down! It's not like I could just strike it up with the champion in front of the Armorless assassins.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: But, she still rescued an Infected like me, even with eyes on her.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Maybe she really is the Radiant Knight. The very same... as the Infected dream about.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: The what now–– Eh, whatever. How about the poor guy you rescued? The old one?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: He...
You asking about me?

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: My arrow's nocked, Infected.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: You'll help me make those lowlife assassins pay the price.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: Amiya, and the Doctor of Rhodes Island, please come in. Treat this place as your own home.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: Your rooms are upstairs. The doctors are working up on the twelfth floor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Thank you, kind sir.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: Haha... There's no need to be so formal, Miss Amiya.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: I never expected the leader of Rhodes Island to be such a lovely, young Cautus girl. Ah, to be young and full of promise.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Th-There's nothing special about me...

options: It's true, Amiya is the face of Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: D-Doctor...

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: Haha, are you embarrassed?

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: What an adorable girl. If I had a granddaughter, I reckon she'd be about your age.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: My my, her face is beet red.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: But, I must apologize. Considering your unique status, I can't arrange an in-person meeting for you two.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mhm... Don't worry, that's perfectly understandable.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: So... 'Gravel.'

steps.name: Senomy
steps.text: Your orders.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: This young lady here is a fourth-order campaign knight. You can call her 'Gravel.' She's very promising.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Hello.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: She will personally take charge of your safety while you are in Kawalerielki. Should you need anything, just let her know, and she will be of service.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: We cannot allow any misfortune to befall our distinguished guests from abroad, not to mention such excellent partners as yourselves, during the Major.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We understand, sir.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: Thank you for your understanding. I've prattled on for long enough, so I'll leave you young people to your business.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: Gravel, please take good care of the Rhodes Islanders.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: As you wish.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Now then... I'll be standing outside the door. If something comes up, just call for me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Right, okay. Thanks, Gravel.

options: Amiya. Hey, Amiya. Is she staring at you?
Excuse me, but did you need something?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: There is one thing... Do you mind if I come a little closer? Yes, just like this, good.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: ......Mmwah.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Hm? What's wrong? Your face is beet red. That's just how I say hello, so don't think too much about it.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Anyway, I'm Gravel, a knight of Kazimierz. It's a pleasure. Hehehe.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What... What was that all about...?

options: She said it's how she greets everyone.
They have a rather interesting way of greeting people here in Kazimierz.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Err, umm... I have heard that sometimes nobles will indeed greet each other with a kiss... And, umm, seeing as how she's a knight...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That's probably all she meant with it, right? Probably...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Haah...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yeah... I guess I have been a bit nervous.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But, that old lady seemed a lot more easygoing than the other Adeptus knights we met earlier.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: How about you, Doctor? Are you tired?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Of course you are. We've been tied up with business and all kinds of formalities since we got to Kazimierz.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: At least you can catch your breath now.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ahaha.... Doctor, were you able to take a breather as well?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It would be nice if all the people in charge of the medical mission were as reasonable as that old lady.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But, this is a rare opportunity for us.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's said that every few years, the Grand Knight Territory will select a few of the most rapidly developing cities to merge with its own core city.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's a remarkable feat, if you think about it.

options: The lights from the billboards outside sure are bright.
I always expected this city to be a lot more solemn.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mm... It's been a bit of a shock for me as well.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Even though... I've always heard Nearl talk about her homeland, I never expected the heart of Kazimierz to be like this.

options: Want to take a look around?
Is there anything you'd like to buy?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hwuh? Ah, um, n-not really... I just don't get to visit big cities like this very often.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: After all, how many Infected get to look out over a thriving city from atop a high-rise hotel...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If Rhodes Island didn't manage to secure a medical business contract, we'd never get to enjoy this luxury.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The only thing is...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I can't stop wondering about Nearl... and how she's doing right now.

options: I was shocked when she suddenly announced that she was leaving Rhodes Island.
She is the Radiant Knight after all, and this is her home.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mhm...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ultimately, we should trust her. This is her decision to make.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I just hope she's safe and sound...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But, since Shining and Nightingale are with her, she'll be fine, right?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yup! Let's put our faith in Nearl.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: After all, she is the Radiant Knight—a pinnacle of Kazimierz knighthood, right?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh, Doctor! Quick, look at that big screen outside!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Is that... Nearl?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Margaret, I'm done!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Based on the suggestions you made last time, I adjusted the center of mass and added a retracting function. Now, it should be able to...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...Margaret?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: What's on your mind?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Oh, Maria... Sorry, what were you talking about?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: You don't usually space out like that. What's wrong?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I heard some of the rumors while I was at Rhodes Island...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: But this place... really has changed a whole lot.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Yeah... We've sold off a lot of the furniture.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: You know Uncle. Were it not for him, we might've moved somewhere else last year.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Yesterday, someone from the Knights Association came by again to harass us. Both you and I, we're always representing some knightclub, or the family. Otherwise...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Don't worry. I'll take care of it.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Hehe, now that's how a big sister should be.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Oh, right, here's your weapon. Master Kowal and I tuned it up for you.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: But, you haven't had any matches lately, right? How'd it get worn out so badly? It's like a bomb went off next to it.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I never realized it before. The sheer number of Infected living in the Grand Knight Territory.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...Margaret?
Margaret gazes wordlessly at the skyscrapers in the distance.
She can't forget the dark, garbage-choked underground, or the flickering glow of flames.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Now, the Infected can become knights. The Blood Knight did something incredible. Judging by the results, he saved many Infected from misfortune.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: But, this is not what a 'knight' should be. The Infected should not be callously treated as playthings just because they suffer from a disease.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Sona... might've just wanted to help those Infected as well.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: The factory is running, the mines haven't stopped. The city is still developing, and more and more Infected will end up at the bottom.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: They were all going to be exiled into the wilderness... but Pinus Sylvestris paid for them. Bought all those Infected with no home of their own.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: That's what Master Kowal told me.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Except, that doesn't change anything. They still don't have a place in this city.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Right... some Infected knights have done similar things before, but there's a limit to how many of the Infected poor the General Chamber of Commerce will allow to hide in the city.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: ...and the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi Kazimierz will?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: The ruling class is even more reluctant to watch the Infected walk openly in their city, and they'll also take measures.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: All the news talks about lately is the Infected, and Oripathy research conferences...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: They're whipping up hysteria.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: They media's trying to make ordinary people fear the Infected, even if it threatens to undo the stabilizing effect that the Infected Knights Act has had––

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: ––and the scary part is, this kind of rhetoric from the media... almost always succeeds.
Don't always look so glum. No money falls into the pockets of the despondent.
The Radiant Knight is answering a higher calling, helping out the Infected hidden throughout the dark alleys of the city. How noble––

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: And then what?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Can she give them their lives back? Can she treat their Oripathy? Can she help the Infected fight back against the rest of society?
Who knows? Maybe she can.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Cut the crap, Toland.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Do you have nothing better to do? Why don't you leave the Grand Knight Territory and crawl back to your den of thieves?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Now that the two sisters are safe and sound, there's no more room for me here?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: You've already been paid back.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: That little bit of cash was just a formality. You know exactly the currency we deal in, Master Młynar.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Who gave you permission to come in?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Mmhmm, this carpet isn't half bad.. The Leithanian textiles are being auctioned off tomorrow, yes?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: That's none of your concern.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: The origins of those two Sarkaz knights certainly raise eyebrows. As a Sarkaz myself, I do pity the fate of those 'knights.'

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: But I must remind you, this is no longer part of our business arrangement. My work here was done long ago.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: I had my own reasons for coming to Kawalerielki, since it's not something I do often. I wanted to see if we could come to a mutual understanding–– but it seems that isn't possible.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Now now, don't make that face. Our relationship is already much better than it was before, Your Excellency.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: After all, I'm just a no-name bounty hunter. To the Grand Knight Territory, I'm nothing at all. As for you–– Oh my, haha. Sorry.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: It would seem that you're nothing as well. I guess that makes us two peas in the same sickly pod.
